correctness.rationale: The addition theorem yields Gram=(ell+1)/24 U_ell(dot products). Exact 24-vertex counting proves B²=8I+3B+4C+RB, C²=6(I+R)+4C, BC=3(B+RB). Their commuting decomposition has rank multiplicities (1,2,9,4,8). Chebyshev parity gives every eigenvalue exactly; periodic sin values give all exceptional ranks and cutoff 11. The packaged symbolic checker verifies the identities, projector multiplicities and matrices for ell=0..48; the proof covers all ell. The normalization and antipodal parity have been checked independently.
